note_gaps: code/md/comfree_sim_2026.md is README + file tree only; no Warp kernel source for Algorithm 1 was captured, so solver/kernel detail is from the paper text only.
contact_model: complementarity-free, analytical (closed-form) contact resolution in the dual cone of the Coulomb friction cone via a prediction-correction/impedance-style update, extended to a unified 6D model (normal, tangential, torsional, rolling friction)
solver: no complementarity solve; a 4-kernel GPU pipeline (Algorithm 1: smooth-velocity prediction, per-contact/per-face dual-cone solve, generalized-impulse accumulation, velocity correction) computes the impulse in closed form per contact facet
throughput: AMD 32-core CPU + NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU: ~3x faster (near-linear vs. MJWarp's superlinear) step time vs. contact count at 512 parallel envs; ~2x parallel-environment throughput vs. MJWarp at 256-4096 envs (Allegro-hand cube-grasping benchmark); on real LEAP-hand MPC (AMD 32-core CPU + RTX 4090), MPPI compute 13.9-28.2 ms vs. MJWarp's 34.0-68.8 ms (~2.4x average speedup)
